DONE

The project is written but not built or run. Gradle is not installed and I was not allowed to use the network. The file `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties` was blocked by a permission check, so the Gradle wrapper is missing; open the project in Android Studio or run `gradle wrapper` to create it.

The app is a Jetpack Compose app that pages through the catalogue from a REST API, shows cover thumbnails with Coil, and searches as you type. The API base URL is a placeholder (`https://library.example.org/api/`) in `app/build.gradle.kts`; set it to the real server. The app expects `GET books?q=&page=&per_page=` to return a JSON array of books with `id`, `title`, `author`, `year`, `isbn` and `cover_url`.
